owner_authority: Owner explicitly assigned all acquisition and data-quality/governance issues to a permanent P10 line; other lines must not perform that work.
owner_request: 那我们单独把P10划成永久的数据线，把数据采集和质量治理的issue都交给P10去，而其他线不得折腾数据质量和数据治理
p10_owns: ODS/DWD construction, scheduled collection, recovery and mirroring
shared data-quality diagnosis, backfill, correction and exception disposition
raw source/version/publication evidence, PIT time semantics and missing manifest recovery
shared data-product numerical consistency, reproducibility, lineage and retention
versioned immutable data publication and consumer handoff
consumer_lines_may: declare required inputs and domain-specific applicability
verify published input identities and authorized scope at admission
register a bounded defect report and P10 dependency without repairing inputs
choose a business bypass, temporary ignore or acceptance of a known limitation after issue registration
accept or reject a P10 handoff against the consuming contract
develop domain features, targets, models, strategies and consumption logic from admitted inputs
continue business work that does not breach an existing hard safety/PIT/activation gate
consumer_lines_must_not: search remote/local data archives as a source-recovery project
repair, impute, reinterpret or privately supplement deficient input data
change canonical source schemas, PIT availability evidence or data-quality policies
publish repaired data or maintain a parallel temporary quality pipeline
weaken cutoffs, windows, truth/reference or activation gates to avoid a P10 dependency

prior_research_temporary_authority.new_consumer_runs_with_temporary_patches: No new private data repair/recovery. Existing immutable artifacts may be referenced only within their original authority and an explicit business disposition; full qualification still needs a P10 versioned handoff and consumer acceptance.

handoff_required: exact immutable source/member inventory and hashes
scope, universe, source and schema versions
raw acquisition/publication/effective/knowledge clock semantics with evidence grade
coverage and exclusions with explicit unresolved reason codes
versioned correction policy and complete exception controls
independent construction or verification required by the consuming gate
replacement comparison and retained lineage for prior temporary artifacts

invariants.SSH_override_scope: existing #424 programme only; not all P10 work

consumer_issues.scope: Retained B consumer admission and strategy-verification readiness only; source recovery and repair belongs to P10.
Research corpus/split/reference qualification from P10-published inputs; no collection, backfill, source recovery or quality repair.

retained_consumer_examples.scope: accepted-package reuse in downstream research jobs; no source repair
prospective consumption access and impact disposition; source correction is P10 work

owner_followup: 以后非数据线业务遇到数据质量/治理相关问题只能提issue，不得自行处理，业务要么选择绕行，要么选择暂时忽略或接受，聚焦业务问题本身。

business_dispositions.bypass: Use an already admitted alternative or disable an optional capability; record any business-policy change with a new version. Never substitute repaired data or silently shrink a frozen window.
business_dispositions.temporarily_ignore: Defer a nonessential data-dependent capability and continue unaffected business work; keep its issue and unavailable status visible.
business_dispositions.accept_known_limitation: Explicitly record purpose, limitation, impact and evidence grade for a business result allowed by its existing contract; never claim missing evidence is established or data is repaired/qualified.

consumer_stop_rule: Stop only the affected step when an existing hard safety, PIT, protected-partition or activation gate cannot be met. Registering a data issue does not automatically stop the whole business line.
